name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 1 Basic — Blood Rage

system.description:
With a touch, the Warlock stirs the vitae in another's veins to a boil of purpose not their own, forcing their very blood to answer a stranger's will.

Establish light contact with your victim, which may require a Physical Challenge against a wary subject. If you get a firm grip, you immediately force the subject to spend a single Blood Trait in any fashion you mentally decide, even beyond the vampire's usual per-turn limits on blood expenditure. You might force them to swell their strength, heal wounds (possibly even rousing from torpor) or simply sweat blood from their pores. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
